description: This file defines the EmployeeModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system. The class models an employee entity for the API, using traits and interfaces to facilitate serialization and normalization. It initializes property filters and attribute mappings for an Employee entity, following the system's internal architecture.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: Represents an Employee entity for serialization and normalization within the OrangeHRM API. Implements the Normalizable interface and uses the ModelTrait to provide serialization capabilities. Configures attribute mapping and filtering for employee data.
